items.prompt: Black to move. White has just spent a move on the rook pawn. Bring a piece out.

claims.statement: The accepted moves are within 40 centipawns of the engine's best at depth 16.
a6 is at least 20 centipawns worse than the best move.

hints: White's last move brought no piece out. Count the pieces each side has developed.
A knight or a bishop has a useful square. A rook-pawn move does not bring a piece out.
Nf6 and Bc5 both work.
items.explain: Nf6 and Bc5 each put a minor piece to work and the engine rates both within 40 centipawns of its best move at depth 16. The rook-pawn move a6 is rated clearly lower.

feedback_by_move.a7a6: a6 does not bring a piece out or help the centre; at depth 16 the engine rates it at least 20 centipawns below the best moves.
